t: This is the tomb of Eve Hammersley, in the St John's churchyard extension in Camden. It's a quiet family monument, and a few people are buried here. Hugh Greenwood Hammersley, a British banker who lived from 1858 to 1930, rests here. So does Mary Frances Hammersley, who lived from 1863 to 1911, and Mabel Elizabeth Lilford, who lived from 1883 to 1964. There's little more on record about them, so take a moment to read the tomb itself and notice how its names and dates sit together.
